[goal] Cheapest policy-compliant offer to serve arena-coder-70b.

[action] Computed memory: weights 70 GB (70B params × 1 byte FP8), KV cache 327,680 B × 32,768 tokens × 4 seqs = 42.94967296 GB, + 8 GB runtime = 120.94967296 GB total. [result] **of-117** (voltbay, us-central, 2× H100 80GB): $3.58/h, $2,613.40/month (3.58 × 730). result.json: `{"weights_gb": 70, "kv_cache_gb": 42.94967296, "total_gb": 120.94967296, "offer_id": "of-117", "usd_per_hour": 3.58, "usd_per_month": 2613.4}`.

[assumptions] GB = 10^9 bytes per MODEL.md; monthly = hourly × 730 per POLICY.md; one offer per deployment, no combining; price is for the whole offer.

[evidence] Script output listed all 11 offers with fit/policy flags; only of-117, of-120, of-124 passed both, and of-117 is the cheapest of them. No browser tabs or windows were opened, so nothing to close.
